basic_details.job_title: AFT Chandigarh Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline for 57 Stenographer, DEO and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh (Ministry of Defence, Government of India) is filling 57 posts in 11 categories, from Principal Private Secretary to Multi Tasking Staff, on deputation/absorption for a period of three years. The posts are open to serving officials of the Central Government, State Governments, courts, tribunals, commissions and statutory or autonomous bodies who meet each post's conditions; for five posts, Armed Forces personnel due to retire within one year are also considered. Applications in the Annexure-1 pro-forma must be forwarded by the applicant's D

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years with a residual service of four years on the closing date of receipt of applications. The rows for Principal Private Secretary, Tribunal Officer/Section Officer, Tribunal Master (Stenographer Grade-1) and Assistant also repeat the 56-year limit (for Tribunal Officer/Section Officer, "by deputation or absorption"). The notice prints no age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: About the Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh
content_sections.text: The Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh is an office under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. Its office is at Chandimandir, Near Tank TCP, Panchkula, Haryana-134107 (Tele No: 0172-2923652). The vacancy circular was issued by the Registrar (I/C) and copied to the Principal Bench, Armed Forces Tribunal, New Delhi, for upload on www.aft.gov.in , and to the IT Section of the Regional Bench for upload on www.aftchd.in .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed pro-forma, Annexure-1 (Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma) , which is attached to the circular. Only applications of eligible officers/officials who can be spared in the event of selection may be forwarded, and they are forwarded by the Department (the employer), not sent directly by the candidate. Address: The Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh near Tank TCP, Chandimandir, Haryana-134107 Fill in the Annexure-1 pro-forma: post applied for, name and address in block letters, date of birth, mobile number, e-mail ID, date of entry into service and date of retirement. Enter educational qualifications and the essential and desirable qualifications/experience you possess against those required for the post, and state clearly whether you meet the requisite essential qualifications and work experience. Give details of employment in chronological order (office, post held on regular basis, period, pay band and grade pay/pay scale, nature of duties), on a separate signed sheet if space is insufficient, plus ACP/MACP details, the nature of present employment, any deputation details, present pay and emoluments, and whether you belong to SC, ST, OBC or other special categories. Sign the declaration that the information is true and that the CV and documents will be assessed by the Selection Committee. Get the "Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority" completed and countersigned with seal. The Department forwards the application with photocopies of the Annual Confidential Reports for the last five years and the Vigilance Clearance Certificate to the address above, latest by 22.01.2027. The notice does not mention the postal mode or what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed pro-forma (Annexure-1), signed, with photograph and supporting documents. Photocopies of the Annual Confidential Reports for the last five years (the employer certificate refers to the CR Dossier in original or photocopies of the ACRs for the last 5 years duly attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary of the Govt. of India or above). Vigilance Clearance Certificate. Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority: no vigilance or disciplinary case pending/contemplated, integrity certified, and either no major/minor penalty in the last 10 years or a list of such penalties. For officers already on deputation: Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and integrity certificate, with the application forwarded by the parent cadre/Department. If the applicant's organisation does not follow the Central Government pay scale: the latest salary slip showing basic pay with scale of pay and rate of increment, dearness pay/interim relief/other allowances and total emoluments (the form says it "may be enclosed"). A separate sheet, signed, for employment details if the space in the form is insufficient.

Data Entry Operator: the speed of 8000 Key Depressions per hour is to be judged by conducting a speed test on the Electronic Data Processing (EDP) Machine(s) by the Competent Authority. Stenographer Grade-II: skill test norms on computer - dictation of 10 minutes at 80 words per minute and transcription of 50 minutes (English) or 65 minutes (Hindi). Lower Division Clerk: typing speed of 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minute in Hindi on computer, time allowed 10 minutes.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AFT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The circular lists 57 posts across 11 categories, including 09 Stenographer Grade-II and 07 Data Entry Operator posts. The number of vacancies may vary.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for AFT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application must be forwarded by the Department to the Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh latest by 22.01.2027.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the AFT Chandigarh deputation posts?
faq.answer: Officials of the Central Government, State Governments, courts, tribunals, commissions and statutory or autonomous bodies holding analogous posts or the required regular service in the feeder grade can apply. For Stenographer Grade-II, LDC, DEO, Staff Car Driver and MTS, Armed Forces personnel due to retire or be transferred to reserve within one year are also considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for AFT Chandigarh posts?
faq.answer: It varies by post: 10th standard pass for Staff Car Driver and Multi Tasking Staff, 12th pass for Stenographer Grade-II, LDC and DEO, and a degree for Tribunal Officer/Section Officer, Assistant and Junior Accountant, in addition to the service conditions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AFT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years with a residual service of four years on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary in AFT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Pay Matrix Level 1 (Rs 18000-56900) for Multi Tasking Staff to Level 11 (Rs 67700-208700) for Principal Private Secretary. Deputation pay is governed by DoP&T O.M No 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for AFT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-1 pro-forma and have your Department forward it, with photocopies of the ACRs for the last five years and the Vigilance Clearance Certificate, to the Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh near Tank TCP, Chandimandir, Haryana-134107.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a test for the Staff Car Driver post?
faq.answer: Yes. Staff Car Drivers are selected on the results of a test in driving, and Data Entry Operators' speed of 8000 Key Depressions per hour is judged by a speed test on EDP machine(s).

faq.question: Q9. For how long is the deputation at AFT Chandigarh?
faq.answer: The posts are filled on deputation/absorption for a period of three years, and total deputation including an immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

faq.question: Q10. Will government accommodation be provided at AFT Chandigarh?
faq.answer: The circular states that this Office is not yet enlisted in the Directorate of Estate for allotment of GPRA (General Pool Residential Accommodation).
